verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Merchant of Record add-on makes Airwallex the legal seller and manages sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance for each sale without rebuilding the payments integration. However, it is in beta with limited eligibility and supports digital products only (no physical goods), so it does not cover every transaction. Missing for 10: a generally available tax calculation and collection capability, support for physical goods, tax handling outside MoR (e.g., native tax on Billing invoices and subscriptions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
